text: Scott Sakakihara has not called the war in Gaza a genocide or acted to block arms transfers to Israel. In 2024 he pushed the Union City council toward a Gaza ceasefire resolution and advocated an ethical investment policy, and he opposes delegitimizing Israel while supporting dialogue and the safety of all people. He holds the preferred tier from CAIR Action and an endorsement from the Muslim Democrats and Friends Club of Alameda County, alongside an endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club. His platform for California State Senate District 10 spans housing production, universal healthcare, universal preschool, criminal justice reform, civil liberties guardrails on AI and biotech, and climate strategy. He is the only candidate in this race with a documented record of community engagement and stated policy positions.
